title: Repeating 'basically' and fillers
title_ko: 같은 표현이나 filler word를 반복하는 발표
description: Fillers and the phrase 'basically' pile up on the method slide. A single repetition prompt helps; a later small relapse is ignored.

events.transcript_chunk: Um, so basically GazeFlow uses a webcam to, um, find regressions.
Basically, uh, when you, um, look back at a word, basically a glossary pop-up shows up.

ground_truth.note: Rising, but could settle on its own.

events.transcript_chunk: And, um, basically, it's, uh, basically all local, basically no video is stored.

ground_truth.note: Six uses of 'basically' within a minute; audience attention is dropping.

events.transcript_chunk: We ran a within-subjects study with 24 participants.
